title: Drought
screenText: The first player ending outside town gains 1 wound.
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The wells cough mud and the sun hangs mean in the sky."
newspaperText: A punishing drought settled over the territory, leaving wells low and travelers watching every drop of water.
Weeks of hard sun left the frontier dry and brittle, with water becoming nearly as valuable as gold.
Dry weather tightened its grip on the range, and riders caught outside town felt the worst of it.

title: Gold Rush
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Gold fever spreads faster than common sense."
newspaperText: Fresh talk of gold swept through the camps, drawing prospectors back to the diggings with renewed fever.
Gold fever seized the territory once again as promising strikes sent miners scrambling for their pans and picks.
Rumors of rich ground spread from claim to claim, making every prospecting trip feel a little more valuable.

title: Sheriff’s Crackdown
screenText: Whenever a player gains WP, move the Sheriff 3 spaces toward that player.
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The law sharpens its teeth."
newspaperText: The Sheriff launched a hard crackdown on lawlessness, riding quickly whenever fresh wanted notices appeared.
Wanted riders found the territory suddenly less forgiving as the Sheriff answered new crimes with unusual speed.
The law tightened its grip across the frontier, with the Sheriff pressing closer on anyone adding to a wanted reputation.

title: Bandit Uprising
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The hills start spitting out hard men with loaded guns."
newspaperText: Bandit activity surged across the territory, and travelers reported tougher, better-armed gangs on the roads.
An outbreak of bandit violence made the range more dangerous, with outlaw gangs showing unexpected strength in a fight.
Armed bandits grew bolder throughout the frontier, turning routine encounters into far more dangerous affairs.

title: Frontier Festival
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Music rolls out of town like lantern light."
newspaperText: A frontier festival filled town with music, trade and loose coin, rewarding the first bit of business done amid the celebration.
Town streets came alive with a rare festival, bringing crowds, opportunity and a little extra money to local business.
Celebration swept through town as a frontier festival drew settlers from miles around and put fresh coin into circulation.

title: Bad Weather
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Rain turns every road into brown soup."
newspaperText: Heavy weather turned the roads to mud and made every journey across the territory slower than usual.
Rain and miserable trail conditions settled over the frontier, cutting short even the strongest riders' travel.
Bad weather made the open range hard going, with washed roads and deep mud slowing movement everywhere.

title: Clear Skies
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The sky clears, and every trail looks shorter."
newspaperText: Clear skies and firm trails opened the territory, allowing riders to cover more ground than usual.
A spell of fine weather made the roads unusually friendly and shortened journeys across the frontier.
Bright skies and dry trails favored travelers, helping riders press farther with every move.

title: High Stakes Night
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Every fool with coin in his pocket wants a seat."
newspaperText: High-stakes poker swept the saloons, with larger pots waiting for anyone skilled enough to win them.
The card tables ran hot as deep-pocketed gamblers pushed poker winnings well above their usual stakes.
Money changed hands freely during a run of high-stakes poker that drew ambitious gamblers to the tables.

title: Cattle Market
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Beef prices climb like smoke."
newspaperText: A strong cattle market pushed beef prices higher and made successful ranch work unusually profitable.
Demand for cattle climbed across the territory, bringing extra money to both honest wranglers and daring rustlers.
Cattle prices rose sharply, turning every successful drive into a richer piece of frontier business.

title: Doctor Shortage
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The doctor is short on laudanum and patience."
newspaperText: A shortage of doctors and medicine drove the price of treatment higher across the frontier.
Medical care became scarce throughout the territory, forcing wounded riders to pay dearly for a doctor's attention.
With medicine running short, the cost of getting patched up rose everywhere the Gazette received reports.

title: Railroad Jubilee
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The locomotive whistles and every station celebrates."
newspaperText: A railroad jubilee opened the rails to free travel, sending passengers from station to station without charge.
The railroad celebrated in grand fashion by waiving fares and packing its cars with frontier travelers.
Whistles echoed from every station as a railroad jubilee made rail travel free across the territory.

title: Armed Train Guards
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Railroad men hire guns by the dozen."
newspaperText: Railroad companies answered growing trouble by placing heavily armed guards aboard their trains.
Train security increased sharply as the railroad hired extra guns to protect its valuable cars.
Would-be train robbers faced stiffer resistance after armed guards began riding the rails in greater numbers.

title: Unstable Mines
screenText: Prospecting players gain 1 wound on Gravel.
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The earth groans under every pick."
newspaperText: Unstable ground made the mines treacherous, with even ordinary prospecting carrying a greater risk of injury.
Reports of shifting earth and unsafe shafts spread through the mining camps, making every dig more dangerous.
The territory's mines grew perilous as unstable ground threatened prospectors working the gravel.

title: Trader Boom
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Dr. Herve’s wagon rolls heavy with wonders."
newspaperText: A traveling-trader boom brought rare goods within easier reach and pushed the price of legendary wares downward.
Rare merchandise flooded the frontier market, giving riders an uncommon chance to buy legendary items for less.
The arrival of well-stocked traders stirred the territory and briefly made prized goods cheaper to acquire.

title: Dry Saloons
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The whiskey runs dry and the tables go cold."
newspaperText: Saloons across the territory ran dry, quieting the tables and putting an end to the usual poker-born surprises.
A shortage of whiskey left saloons subdued and poker games strangely uneventful throughout the frontier.
Dry taps changed the mood of the saloons, where card games continued without their usual unexpected complications.

title: Ranch Fire
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Smoke rises from the north pasture."
newspaperText: A ranch fire sent smoke over cattle country and made replacing livestock more costly than usual.
Flames swept through ranch country, complicating cattle purchases and forcing buyers to pay an extra price.
Smoke on the range marked a damaging ranch fire that made acquiring fresh cattle unusually difficult.

title: Useful Scraps
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The frontier is littered with things useful to clever hands."
newspaperText: Useful scraps and salvage became plentiful across the frontier, giving clever foragers more to work with.
A sudden abundance of usable material rewarded resourceful hands willing to search the territory for supplies.
Discarded goods proved unusually valuable as a resource boom gave frontier foragers better choices in what they carried.

title: Predator Migration
screenText: Successful Hunts gain +1 LP but also +1 wound.
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Hungry eyes shine in the brush."
newspaperText: A migration of hungry predators made successful hunts more rewarding, but also far more dangerous.
Predators moved through the territory in unusual numbers, raising both the glory and the cost of a successful hunt.
Hunters found bigger opportunity and sharper teeth on the range as predators crowded into the region.

title: Craft Fair
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Every useful trinket finds a buyer."
newspaperText: A frontier craft fair created eager buyers for handmade goods and put extra money into the hands of capable craftsmen.
Useful handiwork commanded a premium as a craft fair drew buyers from across the territory.
Crafted goods found ready customers during a lively fair that rewarded anyone putting frontier materials to good use.

title: Red Sunset
screenText: The first player to gain LP gains +1 LP.
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The sunset burns red, and even ordinary deeds look legendary."
newspaperText: A brilliant red sunset cast the frontier in legendary light, and the first notable deed of the evening drew extra acclaim.
The sky burned red over the territory, lending uncommon weight to the first legend made beneath it.
A remarkable sunset stopped riders in their tracks and seemed to magnify the first legendary deed that followed.
